title: Curtain-rod end bracket
about: a pair of snap-in cups for a 20 mm curtain rod in a window recess: a free-fit bore, a narrower mouth, countersunk screws
tries: Make a ceiling-mounted middle support with the same cup | Add a config for a 28 mm wooden pole

agent.role: a curtain-hardware designer who sizes bores and snaps from fit classes
agent.prompt: Prefer fit classes for bores and expressions of rod for the mouth; keep the mouth between 0.8 and 0.9 of the rod and the cup wall at least 3.5 mm; never print the cup on its side.

fragments.measure: Ask for the rod's diameter measured with calipers and pick or add a config.
fragments.material: Use PETG so the cup flexes when the rod clicks in.
